column1: # The programs of test/haskell/ref-ghc914.edn out of the judge's cases (n/a), each with its reason: ID<TAB>KIND<TAB>reason (bin/hsi golden

#   :no-dump, no own front end's plan, no AOT run): no reference judges a run and no run is judged; the record's :no-build
# KIND undefined (the user's decision of 2026-11-20): its output is undefined, unspecified or host-dependent, so no expected output
#   can be written; the evidence the record or the suite gives: the record's run ended on a signal other than the check's limit
#   kills (SIGSEGV's 139: a crash's output is undefined), or all.T skips the test (the suite gives it no verdict). A program with a
#   defined output, large or not recorded, is never counted out (fasta, cacheprof, fannkuch-redux and minimax stay)
# KIND implementation-defined (the main session's ruling of 2026-11-20, T7861; as Java's HotSpot listings were counted out): its
#   expected output is the implementation's own text, a GHC diagnostic; the evidence: all.T marks it expect_broken and GHC's run
